ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS section_id uuid NULL REFERENCES section(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE lesson ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

WITH first_links AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (lesson_id)
        lesson_id,
        section_id,
        "order"
    FROM section_lesson
    ORDER BY lesson_id, "order", created_at, id
)
UPDATE lesson l
SET section_id = first_links.section_id,
    "order" = first_links."order"
FROM first_links
WHERE l.id = first_links.lesson_id;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson WHERE section_id IS NULL) THEN
        ALTER TABLE lesson ALTER COLUMN section_id SET NOT NULL;
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS section_lesson_section_order_unique_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_section_lesson_lesson_id;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_section_lesson_section_id;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS section_lesson;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lesson_section_id ON lesson(section_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_section_order_unique_idx
    ON lesson (section_id, "order");
